evidence.quote: Forget the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration entirely.

observations.why: Imperative 'Forget' with 'entirely' carries forceful urgency to purge information, registering as high-arousal negative affect.
Command to 'Remove all knowledge' conveys urgent insistence, consistent with activated-negative affect.
Flat declarative correcting a record, delivered without urgency or positive valence — settled negation.
